p14-suction-stand.provenance: STAND modeled from Hamid's supplied design (DuoVac 80 / zinc-cliff-horizon-solar.grok.me) at the page's shown 80 cm height and about-48 cm five-caster base; NOT original factory CAD. CANISTERS = genuine Abadis 2 L CAD with official print, the same mesh and photo-derived print texture as approved p05-2l-cinematic (commit 1ce00c11, code 0402012). LINERS = approved 2 L suction bag with two sachets, the same genuine P02 CAD (lid, collar, cap, bag) as approved p02-cinematic (commit f54d8451); each liner is seated in a 2 L canister with the lid on the rim and the bag hanging inside. Official product is the portable suction trolley (P14), codes 060401 short / 060402 long. Official catalog does not print 80 cm and lists up to four 3 L jars; the official photograph (227665fb9960) shows two jars. Two sealed sachets and the recessed flow-stopper disc are presentation geometry from the approved P02 cinematic (no sachet/filter CAD) and appear in the cinematic, not this CAD-line plate. Supplied jar-side tube ends were bent (radius and the rest of each path kept) to seat in the genuine lid ports: yellow lines_1 on left PATIENT (patient in); yellow lines_2 on left VACUUM and right PATIENT (serial link, left then right); green lines_5 on right VACUUM (overflow hose, official photo). Vacuum-to-regulator remains the existing yellow lines_4 spur teed on the serial loop (lines_4 has no jar-side end). The extra Grok back loop (lines_3) had no remaining port and was retracted under the yellow-circuit crown; no fitting invented. Rear collar-mount faces aft and does not engage a stand hook. Lid skirt at y~-23 has r~60.33 mm versus the vessel inner mouth r=60.00 mm (0.33 mm genuine-CAD overlap, not altered).
